subject: How does BYM model work when there are several regions have no neighbors?

messages.author: 3fa01d1518fb40c4
messages.subject: How does BYM model work when there are several regions have no neighbors?
parts:
Dear all,

I have been work on a spatial-temporal model with Japan death data. Japan is a country with many islands, so that means after I use poly2nb function, the result will show many regions with no links. 

For the model fitting function in CARBayes package, it requires each region should have at least one neighbor. I'd like to ask if INLA has such requirement, if not, how does INLA handle this problem in iCAR?

ui|u−i ∼ Normal (1/N(i)*∑aijuj, si^2) 
si^2=sigma^2 / N(i)

where N(i) is the denominator representing the number of neighbors, so I think N(i) cannot be 0?

Looking forward to you reply, thank you so much.

Regards,
Yijing
